draft.emotion: brief and dry, slightly uncomfortable as if the throat is itchy
notes: Often combined with other nouns, as in ไอน้ำ (water vapor, steam) or ไอแดด (heat haze from the sun).
Do not confuse with the homophone verb ไอ ('to cough'). To say 'a cough' as a noun, Thai uses อาการไอ (symptom of coughing).
